#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <stdexcept>
#include <cctype>
#include <climits>

class InputReader {
public:
    std::istream& is;
    std::vector<char> buf;
    int pos;
    int size;

    InputReader(std::istream& is) : is(is), buf(1024), pos(0), size(0) {}

    int nextInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isWhitespace(c))
            c = read();
        int sign = 1;
        if (c == '-') {
            sign = -1;
            c = read();
        }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9')
                throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isWhitespace(c));
        return res * sign;
    }

private:
    int read() {
        if (size == -1)
            throw std::runtime_error("Input mismatch");
        if (pos >= size) {
            pos = 0;
            size = is.readsome(&buf[0], buf.size());
            if (size <= 0)
                return -1;
        }
        return buf[pos++] & 255;
    }

    static bool isWhitespace(int c) {
        return c == ' ' || c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\t' || c == -1;
    }
};

class TaskG {
public:
    static std::vector<double> cs;
    static std::vector<double> sn;
    static std::vector<double> csi;
    static std::vector<double> sni;

    static void initialize() {
        cs.resize(1 << 20);
        sn.resize(1 << 20);
        csi.resize(1 << 20);
        sni.resize(1 << 20);
        for (int len = 1; len <= (int)cs.size(); len <<= 1) {
            for (int i = len / 2; i < len; i++) {
                cs[i] = cos(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                sn[i] = sin(2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                csi[i] = cos(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
                sni[i] = sin(-2 * M_PI * (i - len / 2) / len);
            }
        }
    }

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, std::ostream& out) {
        int mod = 998244353;
        int n = in.nextInt();
        int k = in.nextInt();
        std::vector<int> v(10, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int x = in.nextInt();
            v[x] = 1;
        }
        std::vector<int> ans = {1};
        int p = n / 2;
        while (true) {
            if (p % 2 != 0) {
                ans = multiplyMod(ans, v, mod);
            }
            p /= 2;
            if (p == 0) break;
            v = multiplyMod(v, v, mod);
        }
        int res = 0;
        for (int x : ans) {
            res = (int)((res + (long long)x * x) % mod);
        }
        out << res << std::endl;
    }

private:
    std::vector<int> multiplyMod(const std::vector<int>& a, const std::vector<int>& b, int mod) {
        int need = a.size() + b.size() - 1;
        int n = std::max(2, (int)std::max(1U, 1U << (32 - __builtin_clz(need - 1))));
        if (n < need) n <<= 1;

        std::vector<double> aReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> aImaginary(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)a.size(); i++) {
            int x = (a[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            aReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            aImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(aReal, aImaginary, false);

        std::vector<double> bReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> bImaginary(n, 0.0);
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)b.size(); i++) {
            int x = (b[i] % mod + mod) % mod;
            bReal[i] = x & ((1 << 15) - 1);
            bImaginary[i] = x >> 15;
        }
        fft(bReal, bImaginary, false);

        std::vector<double> faReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> faImaginary(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> fbReal(n, 0.0);
        std::vector<double> fbImaginary(n, 0.0);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            int j = (n - i) & (n - 1);

            double a1r = (aReal[i] + aReal[j]) / 2;
            double a1i = (aImaginary[i] - aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2r = (aImaginary[i] + aImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double a2i = (aReal[j] - aReal[i]) / 2;

            double b1r = (bReal[i] + bReal[j]) / 2;
            double b1i = (bImaginary[i] - bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2r = (bImaginary[i] + bImaginary[j]) / 2;
            double b2i = (bReal[j] - bReal[i]) / 2;

            faReal[i] = a1r * b1r - a1i * b1i - a2r * b2i - a2i * b2r;
            faImaginary[i] = a1r * b1i + a1i * b1r + a2r * b2r - a2i * b2i;

            fbReal[i] = a1r * b2r - a1i * b2i + a2r * b1r - a2i * b1i;
            fbImaginary[i] = a1r * b2i + a1i * b2r + a2r * b1i + a2i * b1r;
        }

        fft(faReal, faImaginary, true);
        fft(fbReal, fbImaginary, true);
        std::vector<int> res(need);
        for (int i = 0; i < need; i++) {
            long long aa = (long long)(faReal[i] + 0.5);
            long long bb = (long long)(fbReal[i] + 0.5);
            long long cc = (long long)(faImaginary[i] + 0.5);
            res[i] = (int)((aa + ((bb % mod) << 15) + ((cc % mod) << 30)) % mod);
        }
        return res;
    }

    void fft(std::vector<double>& a, std::vector<double>& b, bool inverse) {
        int n = a.size();
        int shift = 32 - __builtin_ctz(n);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            int j = __builtin_reverse(i) >> shift;
            if (i < j) {
                double temp = a[i];
                a[i] = a[j];
                a[j] = temp;
                temp = b[i];
                b[i] = b[j];
                b[j] = temp;
            }
        }
        for (int len = 2; len <= n; len <<= 1) {
            int halfLen = len >> 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i += len) {
                int w = cs.size() / len;
                for (int j = 0, k = 0; j < halfLen; j++, k += w) {
                    double wA = inverse ? csi[halfLen + j] : cs[halfLen + j];
                    double wB = inverse ? sni[halfLen + j] : sn[halfLen + j];
                    double uA = a[i + j];
                    double uB = b[i + j];
                    double vA = a[i + j + halfLen] * wA - b[i + j + halfLen] * wB;
                    double vB = a[i + j + halfLen] * wB + b[i + j + halfLen] * wA;
                    a[i + j] = uA + vA;
                    b[i + j] = uB + vB;
                    a[i + j + halfLen] = uA - vA;
                    b[i + j + halfLen] = uB - vB;
                }
            }
        }
        if (inverse) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                a[i] /= n;
                b[i] /= n;
            }
        }
    }
};

std::vector<double> TaskG::cs;
std::vector<double> TaskG::sn;
std::vector<double> TaskG::csi;
std::vector<double> TaskG::sni;

int main() {
    TaskG::initialize();
    TaskG solver;
    solver.solve(1, std::cin, std::cout);
    return 0;
}
